heading: External Restoration by Complete Restoration
subheading: Sympathetic and knowledgeable building facade restoration is a specialised skill encompassing several highly prized trades
introHtml: From hand-carving stone and the replacement of sections worn away through years of exposure to the elements, to the installation of new timber around long decayed window frames. Metal, brick or stone – whatever the material, time and weather will eventually wear it away. At Complete Restoration we have these highly specialised trades that can bring period beauty back to life.
